Video of the crash occurring:

https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/ac4a9c88-9adf-47d5-b7ea-b8038abb35e2

Note that you shouldn't hold <kbd>Shift</kbd> when pressing <kbd>Enter</kbd>.

I would probably fix this by discarding the autocompletion box when using <kbd>Shift</kbd> + arrow keys, just like in VS Code. This should happen in all directions (up/down/left/right). This was indeed the behavior in 4.3, prior to the regression.

**Edit:** I've tried to bisect the regression (it's between 4.4.dev6 and 4.4.dev7), but results were inconclusive, even though I could reproduce the crash multiple times in commits where it did happen. For me, the bisect pointed to dc5f1b7a, but checking out that commit doesn't result in a crash.

I took a look at this issue.
So, in this function `CodeEdit::confirm_code_completion`, the autocompletion is applied at cursors by default.
In selection case, these cursors point to the end of selections in which becomes empty lines after replacement.
I think modifying these cursors to point to the start of selections when it detects a selection case would solve this issue.
